decisive_counterexamples.group700_line_attribute: Twin group 06/22 HW-1.2 (1C9WC00000096J70AI) has a line with 'Group Number = Group 700' (q7_twin_groupnum.json) AND its HW record Group_Number_List__c=null -- the precise key-mismatch H5 posits, in a non-failing group.
decisive_counterexamples.accepted_usd_hwtype: 06/22 HW-1.2 is Accepted, USD, 4 software lines, HW-type, HW-stamped -- a near-perfect twin of the failing group differing ONLY by single-SM (all TermDefined) vs failing mixed OneTime+TermDefined. q3_quote_status.json
decisive_counterexamples.custom_hw_apex_not_on_delete: QuoteLineGroupTrigger live: UsageBeforeDelete=false, UsageAfterDelete=false, after-update only (q5_trigger_events.json). Cannot run on delete; would throw System.NullPointerException not java.util.Map.get NPE anyway.

sole_real_discriminator: Mixed selling-model composition (OneTime + TermDefined in one group). Of 25/17 HW-type groups, the failing one is the ONLY mixed-SM group (q2 / Mission E all_hwgroup_sm.json). This is H1 territory, not the hardware dimension.
conclusion: Every component of H5's hardware-specific mechanism is reproduced in deletable groups. The hardware dimension is incidental/coincidental; the discriminator is SM-mix.
